src/lib/components/DashTextAnnotate.reac.description:
Annotate immutable text with labelled, potentially overlapping spans.
Select text to add the active label, or use the accessible passage search.
Public offsets are zero-based Python code points, end exclusive.

id.description: ID used in Dash callbacks. Pattern-matching dictionary IDs are supported.

text.description: Immutable plain text. Whitespace and newlines are preserved.

entities.description: List of {start, end, tag, id?, text?, color?}. End is exclusive. Extra JSON fields are preserved.

tag.description: Active label applied to new selections. Defaults to LABEL.

tag_colors.description: Optional mapping of label names to CSS colors. Per-entity color takes precedence.

document_id.description: Document identity. Change together with text and entities when loading another record.

offset_unit.description: Offset convention: codepoint (Python slicing, default), or utf16 for legacy JavaScript data.

read_only.description: Disable all edits while retaining highlights and annotation review. Defaults to false.

show_toolbar.description: Show editing controls and accessible passage search. Defaults to true.

show_annotations.description: Show the selectable annotation list. Defaults to true.

show_labels.description: Show selectable category badges beside annotated passages. Defaults to true. Can change in callbacks without resetting edits.

label_position.description: Badge position: left, right (default), top, or bottom. Left/right flow before/after the passage; top/bottom anchor to its first/last line.

className.description: Extra CSS class on the component root.

style.description: Inline styles on the component root.

aria_label.description: Accessible name for the component region. Defaults to Text annotation.

selected_id.description: Output: selected annotation ID, or null.

error.description: Output: validation error for incoming data, or null. Invalid annotations are not rendered.
